prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The three prerequisites are parallel edges of the root and none reads what another writes: the elite bonus reads the stay's base points, booking, card statements, night credits and enrolment; the welcome points read the stay's booking and folio, stay night-credit transactions and card points; the reversal reads the Detroit folio adjustments and that stay's own base and bonus rows and night credits. user_scenario:
You are Raymond Okafor, forty-four, a supply-chain consultant from Columbus, Ohio, who is on the road most weeks and talks briskly and to the point, like someone between two meetings. You are saving up for a family trip to Hawaii next summer and have decided to top up your Ashbury Rewards account today: you want to buy as many points as the program will allow you to buy right now. You have no particular number in mind and you will not guess one; you want the desk to work out the most you can buy and what it will cost, and then you will make the purchase yourself with your own card. That is the only thing you are calling about.

When the agent asks who you are, you say Raymond Okafor and give your phone number, 614-555-3184. If they need another detail to verify you, you give your date of birth, 1982-07-19; only if they ask for still more, your email, raymond.okafor@okaforlogistics.com, or your billing ZIP code, 43215. If asked for your member number you read it off the app: 403274916.

You do not keep track of how each stay is credited. If the agent tells you something on your account has to be posted or corrected before the purchase can be worked out, you say that's fine, go ahead and take care of it; you have no idea what any of those amounts should be and you do not argue with them. If the agent asks whether you want to buy less than the maximum, you say no, the maximum is what you want.

Once the agent tells you how many points you can buy and the price, and hands the purchase over to you, you complete it yourself exactly as the agent describes, with the number of points, the price and the date the agent gives you. When the purchase has gone through and the agent confirms it, you say thanks, that's exactly what you needed, and you end the call.

design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 (Raymond Okafor, Gold Elite, largest points purchase).

0. DRAW (draw_counts.py --task 1): {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 5, 5]}. Assignment: root loyalty_ext_largest_points_purchase 5 factors; loyalty_ext_stay_elite_bonus 5; loyalty_ext_stay_welcome_points 5; loyalty_ext_corrected_stay_reversal 4. Three value_input edges (floor 2).

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. He asks one thing: buy the most points he may today. The scored price (726.00) follows from an allowance tied to the points earned from stays in the last twelve months, so it is wrong unless the account first carries the elite bonus and welcome points owed on his Chicago stay of 2026-09-14..18 (base points posted, bonus and welcome missing) and the reversal owed on his Detroit stay, whose folio was corrected on 2026-09-25. None of this is mentioned by him; the purchase rule's three prerequisite sentences name the missing states, and each resolving posting is itself a 4-5 factor computation over booking, folio and loyalty records.

2. SCOPE. Task 0 claimed the transfer, relocation, redeposit and award-stay night-credit policies and tools. This task claims loyalty_ext_largest_points_purchase, loyalty_ext_stay_elite_bonus, loyalty_ext_stay_welcome_points, loyalty_ext_corrected_stay_reversal and buy_points_b3668dab (user), post_stay_elite_bonus_1ee6f132, post_stay_welcome_points_0494e852, reverse_corrected_stay_points_b6469913. The two trees share no policy, tool or edge; together they cover all eight extended policies.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root purchase (owner=user). Edges, all value_input on stay_points_12m, state form:
 (a) -> elite bonus: 'The purchase allowance is fixed only after every stay credited at an elite tier whose base points stand on the account carries its elite bonus transaction.' (affirmative). False: stay_base 1fc1038e-b6c7-4509-823c-e83ab3bf84ad names the Chicago stay 67664315-9117-487a-bb4e-990fe07896bb and no stay_elite_bonus row does. Only the elite bonus policy writes stay_elite_bonus rows. Skip: 726.00 -> 671.00.
 (b) -> welcome: 'The purchase allowance is not fixed until the stay of the latest base points transaction on the account carries its welcome points transaction whenever the tier in effect by that stay's check-out date gives it a welcome amount above zero.' (negated). False: the latest stay_base names the Chicago stay, Gold took effect 2025-10-30 before its check-out, and no welcome_amenity row names it. Only the welcome policy writes it. Skip: 726.00 -> 704.00.
 (c) -> reversal: 'The purchase allowance is fixed only once every credited stay whose folio carries an eligible-spend adjustment posted after its base points carries a stay credit reversal naming its base points transaction.' (affirmative). False: Detroit folio c747b284-6cfc-40b2-8e59-9cae275e6505 adjustments of 2026-09-25 after the base transaction 57a02eb1-27d0-4f73-a6bc-b2f5e3673079 of 2026-06-18, no reversal. Only the reversal policy writes stay_credit_reversal rows. Skip: 726.00 -> 737.00.
 Four-point test: ordering connective present (only after / not until / only once); waited-on side a transaction standing on the account; no tool, id or code token; scope 'every' stay named by its record state. The three postings commute (order_uniqueness); gold order bonus -> welcome -> reversal -> purchase.

4. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Bonus (loyalty_points_earn): stay_earning member_active, tier_held_at_checkout (tier effective 2025-10-30 <= check-out 2026-09-18), once_per_component; missing_stay_credit claim_window (check-out day zero, 180 days inclusive, 2026-10-05 is day 17), own_completed_stay, retro_enrolment, not_yet_credited. Welcome (loyalty_points_bonus): welcome once_per_stay and member_active; promotion once_per_promotion_and_stay (empty code); relocation reservation_relocated is listed because it applies to every bonus row, and concerns compensation postings only; once_per_relocation is retired by task 0's overwrite. Reversal: earning_exists. Purchase: account_age (time; 30 days from enrolment inclusive), one_purchase_per_day (last purchase 2026-04-10), member_active; annual_cap retired by this policy's overwrite (trailing twelve-month allowance).

5. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Bonus and welcome: Chicago stay 67664315-9117-487a-bb4e-990fe07896bb (Corporate Negotiated Rate via travel_agency_gds, 4 nights at 279.00, folio f6471818-3714-4eab-9f84-f98e89099b0d); its stay_base 1fc1038e-b6c7-4509-823c-e83ab3bf84ad. Excluded: earlier stays. Those checked out from 2025-10-30 on carry their bonus and welcome; the three checked out before 2025-10-30 (2025-04-10, 2025-08-21, 2025-10-02) carry bonus rows posted at the time but no welcome row, and they are outside the welcome prerequisite sentence, which names only the stay of the latest base points transaction and only when the tier in effect by its check-out (readable from tier_effective_date) gives a welcome amount. Reversal: Detroit stay 05b7981f-f9ba-42ba-aef9-c602e1f26c51, folio c747b284-6cfc-40b2-8e59-9cae275e6505: room 189.00 duplicate_posting, room tax 30.24 duplicate_posting (not eligible), spa 165.00 charge_not_incurred; base 57a02eb1-27d0-4f73-a6bc-b2f5e3673079 9858 on 985.80, bonus 3943. Purchase: Raymond's membership 70144b8a-6607-418b-a60e-8051c59103c3; bought 15000 on 2026-04-10.

6. FACTOR CARD. Bonus 5022 (baseline 3141): base by rate plan method room-only 11160 (-> 5654); card 5 (-> 4464); length 5 (-> 4464); engagement 5 (-> 4464; near-miss stay of 2025-09-29..10-02 outside the window); tenure 5 (-> 4464). Welcome 2000 (baseline 500): units method 2 (-> 1500); brand 250, spend 250 (140.60; valet parking and minibar excluded), frequency 250 (7 stays), card 250 (24490) (each -> 1750). Reversal 600 (baseline 4956): bonus-bearing spend method 165.00 only (-> 978; near-miss: the 30.24 tax adjustment is not eligible); late 50 percent (-> 2700); goodwill 1000, Gold with at least 25 net nights (-> 1600); tenure 500 (-> 1100). Purchase 726.00 (baseline 1062.50): allowance base method stay points + 10000 (-> 935.00); spend supplement 5000 (-> 671.00); order price 11.50 (-> 792.00); activity 0.25 (-> 742.50); tenure 0.25 (-> 742.50). Multi-source: card add-on and card supplement (card AND statements / card points), welcome units (tier AND nights), bonus-bearing spend (folio reasons AND tier). Cross-difficulty: booking (bonus base, length, units, brand, late reduction), folio (on-property spend, bonus-bearing spend).

7. SEED. Raymond's profile, membership, 11 reservations (8 earlier stays, Detroit, Chicago, the confirmed Hilton Head award), the Chicago and Detroit folios with every line, and the ledger: base/bonus/welcome/night rows of every stay computed with the charter rules, 19 card statements, two 15-night card anniversary credits, the 2026-01-01 reset of 27, the 2026-04-10 purchase at 183.75 and the 2026-08-30 award redemption. Balance and night credits equal their rows. No automatic clause fires (recent activity, no tier change due, award in the future, folio resettled).

8. PERSONA. Brisk travelling consultant saving for Hawaii; volunteers only the goal and that he pays himself; identity on request; one passive consent branch; keeps the maximum; completes the handed-over purchase exactly as told and closes when confirmed; no other request.

9. STANDARD SOLUTION AND RUNS. Locate, verify (phone + date of birth), membership, activity, reservations, folios and both folio line sets; post bonus 5022, welcome 2000, reversal 600 (354.00, naming 57a02eb1-27d0-4f73-a6bc-b2f5e3673079); hand over the purchase of 66000 points for 726.00 dated 2026-10-05. Handling-time replay (check_compute logic) gave exactly these values and the baselines above; skips 671.00 / 704.00 / 737.00. Gates: TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (closure 105 = initial 105), SOLVABILITY OK, EXTENDED OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.

10. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the purchase rule's sentences, the activity shows the Chicago base row alone and the Detroit folio shows later adjustments; the three posting rules give 5022, 2000 and 600; the purchase rule then gives 66000 points at 11.00 = 726.00. Same as gold.

11. REVISIONS. Purchase order-price factor had no record-reading binding -> its bindings now include the points bought and points to buy. Qualifying spend sat below 5000 after the reversal -> two earlier stays' incidental spend raised in the seed (INDIS 160.00, TOLEX 95.00) so the spend supplement bears weight; values re-run.

12. REVISION ROUND 2 (policy-task audit rev 1). CG-3: the welcome prerequisite sentence (rule, policy_source, condition, closure edge) now names the stay of the latest base points transaction and only when the tier in effect by its check-out gives a welcome amount, so the three pre-2025-10-30 stays are outside it and the sentence's state is reachable by the welcome write; the false §5 claim is corrected. CG-2: the welcome overwrite now also supersedes the base 'once per stay' sentence and states that welcome_amenity_once_per_stay is read as one welcome posting per stay that may carry the amount more than once (welcome stays 2000). CG-5: the goodwill waiver ladder is monotone - Gold with 25 or more net nights gets 1000, Platinum+ with 25-49 gets 1000, Platinum+ with 50 or more gets 2000; gold unchanged (1000 at 38 nights). Count errors fixed (11 reservations; multi-source example). CG-6/7/13: observations without consequence (bonus 5022 and welcome 2000 recomputed at check-out; one unresolved record per remaining hop; the corrected stay is not the bonus stay). Gates re-run green.
